about: The GripForge kits SDK this compiler is built against: module-kits at a fixed revision. Its core/scene-format (validator, packing, the generator of init_scene.rs) is compiled into dist/gripforge_compiler.wasm, never copied here. npm run sdk fetches it into .sdk/module-kits. Change rev to follow the kits, then npm test (and UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 npm test when the generated code changes on purpose).
